scope: Actual ABAP root, 15 functional documents, two functional/full-code landing pages and the BDC full-program example. Bounded source freshness audit; no UI or published-site mutation.
rawPolicy: All fresh complete tool responses persisted in content-import/latest-abap/raw/<id>.json. Canonical imported bodies and source timestamps unchanged, so no canonical source/manifest row replacement was necessary. Metadata-only request ID formatting changes are not content updates.
findings: All 19 checked titles, source bodies, code blocks and native source edit dates match existing imports.
The actual root prioritizes four independent complete examples: basic lookup → custom control → splitter → CRUD. Section/inclusion snippets are secondary modification references.
Excel is a 9-block integration guide using project DDIC types, not a standalone runnable program.
The BDC full-program example places its Screen Flow Logic first and complete Module Pool second; selecting the first code block by default hides the intended full program.
The latest checked native source edit is Excel at 2026-10-12T01:37:01.403Z. Fresh verification on Oct15 does not imply source content was edited Oct15.

featureEntrypoints.title: 📋 03 기초 조회화면 — SCARR·TOP·SET_LAYOUT·CALL SCREEN 전체 틀
featureEntrypoints.label: 기본 조회 ALV 만들기
featureEntrypoints.intent: 항공사 조건으로 SCARR 조회 → ALV → 새로고침 → 종료
featureEntrypoints.notes: 원문 첫 추천 문서. 프로그램 전체와 화면 Flow Logic을 서로 다른 편집기에 복사한다.

featureEntrypoints.title: ✏️ 11 기초 CRUD 화면 — SCARR 양식·생성·수정·삭제·검증

featureEntrypoints.title: ↔️ 05 Splitter 화면 — SCARR·SPFLI·TOP 선언부터 전체 틀

featureEntrypoints.notes: 선언·두 Grid·이벤트·상세조회가 한 프로그램에 들어 있다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 🔍 13 F4 검색 도움말 — Dynpro 입력칸에 결과 넣기
featureEntrypoints.label: F4 선택값을 입력칸에 넣기
featureEntrypoints.intent: 항공사 F4 선택 → GV_CARRID 반영 → Enter 또는 SHOW로 명칭 조회
featureEntrypoints.notes: PROCESS ON VALUE-REQUEST 화면 Flow Logic 연결을 코드 옆에 보여준다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 🎚️ 14 화면 필드 동적 제어 — LOOP AT SCREEN
featureEntrypoints.label: 필드 입력 켜기·끄기
featureEntrypoints.intent: EDIT 버튼으로 입력칸 활성·비활성을 바꾸고 SHOW로 값 확인
featureEntrypoints.notes: Screen Painter의 Input 허용과 그룹 EDT 설정이 필요하다. ALV 셀 STYLE 제어와 구분해 안내한다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 🔘 12 ALV Toolbar 버튼·클릭 이벤트 연결
featureEntrypoints.label: ALV 툴바 버튼 연결하기
featureEntrypoints.intent: ALV Toolbar 이벤트와 사용자 클릭 이벤트 연결
featureEntrypoints.notes: ALV 내부 ZREFRESH는 SE41에 만들지 않는다. TOOLBAR 이벤트가 생성한다. 화면 GUI Status의 REFRESH는 선택 사항이다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 🪟 10 Popup ALV — 더블클릭으로 상세창 띄우기
featureEntrypoints.label: 더블클릭 상세 팝업 만들기
featureEntrypoints.intent: CARRID 더블클릭 → 해당 노선 팝업 → 닫고 다른 항공사 다시 열기
featureEntrypoints.notes: 프로그램 전체·0100 Flow Logic·0200 Flow Logic 세 블록을 각각 표시한다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 🌳 07 ALV 트리 — 왼쪽 노드·오른쪽 Grid
featureEntrypoints.label: 트리와 상세 ALV 연결하기
featureEntrypoints.intent: 왼쪽 항공사 트리 노드 더블클릭 → 오른쪽 노선 Grid 갱신
featureEntrypoints.notes: CL_GUI_ALV_TREE이며 SIMPLE_TREE와 다르다. 앞부분 전체 예제를 우선하고 아래 기존 프로젝트 발췌는 별도 참고로 둔다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 📥 엑셀 업로드·템플릿 다운로드 — TOP·SMW0·ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE
featureEntrypoints.label: 엑셀 업로드·양식 다운로드 붙이기
featureEntrypoints.intent: TOP → SMW0 양식 → 버튼 → 파일 선택 → 셀/행 변환 → ALV 반영
requiredObjects: 원문 ZTE3QM0004 등 업무 DDIC 타입을 현재 타입으로 교체
featureEntrypoints.notes: 독립 전체 프로그램이 아니라 기존 프로젝트에 붙이는 9개 코드 블록이다. 업로드와 DB 저장은 별도 단계다.

featureEntrypoints.title: 📘 13 BDC FI 전표 입력 — 화면 필드·BDCDATA·FB01
featureEntrypoints.label: BDC로 FI 전표 입력하기
featureEntrypoints.intent: 화면 헤더·차변·대변 입력값을 BDCDATA로 조립해 FB01 전달
featureEntrypoints.notes: 원문 4절의 전체 프로그램이 두 번째 코드 블록이다. 첫 블록은 화면 Flow Logic. SHDB 재녹화로 시스템별 화면·필드 순서를 맞춘다.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js page(): global document/code counts, all-source tabs, group buttons and a flat result list precede task-specific choices.
usabilityGaps.change: Lead ABAP with the 10 task entrypoints in this audit. Present basic lookup → custom control → splitter → CRUD as a visible start sequence. Keep advanced/archive browsing in an optional section.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js results()/score(): archived records are merely penalized by 70 points, without a complete-program / section snippet / archive filter.
usabilityGaps.change: Add content-kind labels and filters. On an ordinary feature query, rank canonical complete-program or integration guide first, then same-feature fragments and original files. Allow archive visibility explicitly.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/content/notion-3f1a6b8522df813c951bd906497f3873.json: group currently 조회조건·화면 동작; first file is Screen 0100 and second file is the full program.
usabilityGaps.change: Give BDC an explicit task entrypoint under program integration. Select the full-program block as the main copy action and give Screen Flow Logic its own clearly labeled action.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js renderReader(): general tabs and full original prose exist, but required-object/setup summary is not structured outside the body.
usabilityGaps.change: Before code, show required program/table/screen/status names and separate copy targets for program source and Screen Flow Logic. Derive these from original instructions; preserve original source unchanged.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js prepareBody(): inline code displays 60 lines; codeText(): full-code tab initially displays 240 lines. Copy is complete, but visual context is still a long source block.
usabilityGaps.change: For canonical full programs, show compact setup, numbered apply steps and a block outline before the expandable editor. Keep original full code downloadable/copyable.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js related(): explicit children plus first 15 documents sharing a group; relationships have no task meaning.
usabilityGaps.change: Label links as full example, insertable section, original GitHub files or prerequisite. For Excel show TOP→SMW0→buttons→file picker→cell conversion→ALV instead of only same-group neighbors.

usabilityGaps.evidence: dist/library.js matches()/synonyms: all split query words must match and aliases are a fixed short global table.
usabilityGaps.change: Attach the feature-specific Korean/ABAP aliases in this audit; searches such as 입력 잠금, 양식 다운로드, 항공사 상세 should land on canonical functional tasks before raw code occurrences.

limitations: UI gaps are verified against the local generated dist/library.js and selected dist/content documents, not a fresh screenshot of the live deployed page. SAP compile/runtime execution is not available in this audit.
